info.desc: I See You is the third studio album by the English indie pop band The xx, released on 13 January 2017 on the Young Turks label. It is the follow-up to their sophomore album Coexist, and is their first release in more than four years. The band announced the album while announcing frequent collaborator Rodaidh McDonald for its production and reportedly working on it on May 2014. Member Jamie xx released his solo debut In Colour in May 2015 and reflected that it would influence the sound and aesthetic of I See You. .

podcast.body: Released in January, this album has been subject to a significant disparity of opinions from both critics and the public. While many important music critics have awarded it high scores, others have given it very low marks, describing it as "absolutely boring." The album was recorded over more than two years, spanning three different cities and two countries, and consists of 10 songs. "acerca del nuevo disco de DXX que salía en enero, hace muy poco y estamos leyendo la escrítica, se estamos escuchando el disco y todos nos estamos haciendo a pregunta en tanto de extraña y es, es realmente bueno el disco de DXX es tan malo como lo cuentan el último disco que han sacado."

srcs.episode: I see you - The XX. ¿Un buen disco o un mal disco?
